name: Snappass
description: Minimal web app for sharing a secret exactly once via a self-destructing link backed by Redis.

envVars.description: Serve over plain HTTP when TLS is handled by a reverse proxy

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      REDIS_PORT: 6379
      SNAPPASS_NO_SSL: {{env.SNAPPASS_NO_SSL}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
